name: Call of Fire
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
There is an Al'Aketh Skypriest called Faladiel. He was once a caller of the flame and a stalwart Windshaper. Like so many Al'Aketh, he mortgaged his loyalty for power and his hands are now stained with the blood of  his former brothers and sisters.

You will find Skypriest Faladiel at the farm to the northeast past Valanaar, just to the south of the Shrine of Akir. Kill the betrayer. Bring me his heart. It is a gruesome task, but it is needed for the ritual we are to perform.
narrative.objectives: Slay Skypriest Faladiel in the Gustberry Lowlands and collect Faladiel's Heart.
narrative.offerRewardText: The Windshapers do not forget, and blood is always paid with blood. It pleases me that you were able to deliver this final, painful reminder of our creed to this traitor.This heart will not be all that feeds the flames today, however. There is one other task that needs to done.
narrative.requestItemsText: The heart of a betrayer is a powerful reagent. The flames will eagerly accept such an offering and burn more intensely as it is consumed.
